description: ETH spot price in USD, aggregated across seven independent venues (CoinGecko, Coinbase, Kraken, Binance, OKX, Gemini, DefiLlama). Returns the lead figure plus every venue quote that answered, so a caller can see the spread rather than trust one exchange. Venues are ranked in a fixed declared order, not completion order, so identical market state always returns the same lead price. Costs 0.001 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana or Base).
